name: Fiakerstüberl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Carriage House in Leutasch**

Step into a world of tradition and charm at the **Fiakerstüberl in Leutasch**, nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**. This cozy inn invites you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality with a warm welcome and hearty dishes.

Savor classic **Kaiserschmarrn**—fluffy, caramelized pancakes torn into pieces—served with fresh fruit compote or a sprinkle of powdered sugar. Pair it with a steaming mug of **Tyrolean coffee** or a frothy glass of **Apfelstrudel** (apple strudel) for dessert.

The rustic ambiance, adorned with wooden beams and traditional decor, transports you back in time. Whether you're seeking a peaceful retreat after a day of hiking or a lively gathering with friends, the **Fiakerstüberl** promises an unforgettable experience in the picturesque **Leutasch Valley**.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this hidden gem is the perfect stop for travelers exploring **Tirol’s** stunning landscapes and rich cultural heritage. Don’t miss the chance to indulge in genuine Tyrolean flavors and stories in this charming alpine retreat.
